source.title: WCA Statement Regarding James Molloy
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We regret to inform you of a serious incident that has come to our attention. 

Recently, the former Treasurer of the World Cube Association (WCA) and former President of the UK Cube Association (UKCA), James Molloy, admitted to misappropriating UKCA funds. Although the exact sum is yet to be determined, we want to emphasize the seriousness of this issue, whilst assuring you that immediate action has been taken. Our foremost priority has been to ensure the security of WCA funds along with conducting an initial review into the WCA’s financials. Our initial review has concluded there is no evidence that the WCA’s financials have been impacted.

We understand the impact and significance of this incident, and the WCA is here to support the UKCA, one of our largest Regional Organizations. We are glad to report that the UKCA remains financially resilient and has confirmed ALL upcoming competitions will go ahead as planned.

With immediate effect, we have removed James Molloy from all WCA positions including Treasurer, WCA Financial Committee (WFC) Leader and Delegate. James has also been banned from competing at any WCA competition until a full investigation of the situation has been conducted. UKCA has removed James from the organization and revoked all of his administrative access.

We are aware of the seriousness of this incident and are doing all we can to resolve it. Both the WCA and UKCA have always been volunteer-led organizations both operating on a non-profit basis, and we will continue to uphold these principles. We will be supporting the UKCA who have expedited plans to transition the UKCA into a newly incorporated limited company as a result of this incident.

The WCA Board and WCA Ethics Committee (WEC) will be conducting a thorough investigation into the events that occurred in the mismanagement of UKCA assets. Separately, we will conduct an in-depth audit of the WCA finances independent of any current WFC member, to ensure proper management of the WCA financials.

While we understand the significance of transparency, we must emphasize that due to the ongoing investigation, the Board, WFC and WEC cannot participate in any additional discussions until the investigation reaches its conclusion. 

WCA Board of Directors

translation.title: WCA 关于 James Molloy 的声明
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们很遗憾地告知大家，近期我们获悉了一起严重事件。

近日，世界魔方协会（WCA）前财务主管、英国魔方协会（UKCA）前主席 James Molloy 承认挪用了 UKCA 资金。具体金额尚待确定，但我们要强调此事的严重性，同时向大家说明，我们已经立即采取行动。我们的首要任务是保障 WCA 资金安全，并对 WCA 财务进行初步检查。初步检查的结论是，目前没有证据表明 WCA 财务受到影响。

我们理解这一事件的影响及严重程度。UKCA 是我们最大的地区组织之一，WCA 将为其提供支持。我们很高兴地告知大家，UKCA 的财务仍然稳健，并已确认，所有即将举行的比赛都会按计划进行。

我们已立即解除 James Molloy 在 WCA 的全部职务，包括财务主管、WCA 财务委员会（WFC）负责人及代表职务。同时，在全面调查完成前，James 被禁止参加任何 WCA 比赛。UKCA 也已将 James 移出组织，并撤销其全部管理权限。

我们清楚此事的严重性，正尽力解决。WCA 与 UKCA 始终由志愿者主导、以非营利方式运作，我们将继续坚持这些原则。事件发生后，UKCA 加快了转型为新注册有限公司的计划，WCA 将支持这一工作。

WCA 董事会与 WCA 道德委员会（WEC）将对 UKCA 资产管理不当的相关事件展开彻底调查。此外，我们将对 WCA 财务进行深入审计，审计独立于所有现任 WFC 成员，以确保 WCA 财务得到妥善管理。

我们理解透明度的重要性，但必须说明，调查仍在进行，因此在调查结束前，董事会、WFC 和 WEC 无法参与进一步讨论。

WCA 董事会
